title: Silent Letters
subtitle: Letters You Don't Pronounce
description: English is full of silent consonants left over from older spellings. Knowing which letters to skip will prevent common mispronunciations and boost your confidence.
tip: When in doubt, say the word out loud the way a native speaker would — many silent letters are simply historical leftovers that were never meant to be heard.
phrases: The knight used his knack for knitting to make a knapsack.
She wrote the wrong answer on her wrist with a marker.
I doubt the plumber can climb the column to fix the debt.
Use a comb to comb your hair before you climb the stairs.
The psychologist on the island had a subtle but honest insight.
The lamb was numb, and the bomb left a crumb on the tomb.
